cold_start.note: Chargement unique; le worker garde ensuite le modèle en mémoire.

interpretation.default_natural_voice: Approximately 8 to 10 minutes of warm generation per hour of output audio in this test.
interpretation.voice_variation: Some cloned voices converge much more slowly. Short-line extrapolation is not a production benchmark.
interpretation.compatibility: OmniVoice recreates its own prompt from each Qwen reference WAV and transcript; Qwen .pt prompt files are not reused.
